# `core/math/BezierCurves.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/math/BezierCurves.js`

BezierCurves.js - Bezier Curve Evaluation and Manipulation Provides cubic Bezier curve operations for procedural generation: - Tree branches, roots, vines - Cave tunnels, worm paths - Structural beams, supports - River/road networks Key Algorithms: - De Casteljau: Numerically stable curve evaluation - Derivatives: Tangent and curvature calculation - Subdivision: Split curves for LOD/approximation - Arc Length: For uniform parameterization Curve Types: - Quadratic (3 control points): Simple, fast - Cubic (4 control points): Standard, flexible - Higher order: Via recursive De Casteljau

## Classes

### `class CubicBezier`

Cubic Bezier curve defined by 4 control points

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(p0, p1, p2, p3, radius = 1.0)` |  |
| `evaluate` | `evaluate(t)` | Evaluate curve at parameter t using De Casteljau's algorithm Numerically stable, works for any degree |
| `evaluatePoly` | `evaluatePoly(t)` | Evaluate using polynomial form (faster for many evaluations) B(t) = (1-t)³P0 + 3(1-t)²tP1 + 3(1-t)t²P2 + t³P3 |
| `derivative` | `derivative(t)` | First derivative (tangent direction, not normalized) B'(t) = 3(1-t)²(P1-P0) + 6(1-t)t(P2-P1) + 3t²(P3-P2) |
| `secondDerivative` | `secondDerivative(t)` | Second derivative (for curvature) B''(t) = 6(1-t)(P2-2P1+P0) + 6t(P3-2P2+P1) |
| `tangent` | `tangent(t)` | Get normalized tangent at t |
| `normal` | `normal(t, up = [0, 1, 0])` | Get normal vector at t (perpendicular to tangent) |
| `curvature` | `curvature(t)` | Get curvature at t κ = |B' × B''| / |B'|³ |
| `subdivide` | `subdivide(t = 0.5)` | Subdivide curve at t into two curves |
| `arcLength` | `arcLength(samples = 16)` | Approximate arc length using Gaussian quadrature |
| `buildArcLengthLUT` | `buildArcLengthLUT(segments = 32)` | Build arc-length lookup table for uniform parameterization |
| `arcLengthToT` | `arcLengthToT(s)` | Convert arc-length parameter to curve parameter |
| `sampleUniform` | `sampleUniform(count)` | Sample curve uniformly by arc length |
| `getBoundingBox` | `getBoundingBox()` | Get bounding box |
| `toGPUData` | `toGPUData()` | Serialize to flat array for GPU upload |
| `fromGPUData` | `static fromGPUData(data)` | Create from flat array |

## Notes & Examples

### Math Library Conventions

The math library provides vector, matrix, quaternion, and utility operations. All math functions follow consistent patterns: **pure functions** return new values, **`*Into` variants** write to an output parameter (zero allocation), and **out parameters come first**. Matrices are column-major for WebGPU compatibility.

**Example: Common math operations**
```js
import { vec3, vec3Add, vec3Scale, vec3Normalize } from 'engine/core/math/MathVec3.js';
import { mat4, mat4Multiply, mat4Perspective, mat4LookAt } from 'engine/core/math/MathMat4.js';
import { quat, quatMultiply, quatFromEuler } from 'engine/core/math/MathQuat.js';

// Vectors
const pos = vec3(1, 2, 3);
const dir = vec3Normalize(vec3(1, 0, 0));

// Matrix: projection * view * model
const proj = mat4Perspective(60 * Math.PI/180, 16/9, 0.1, 1000);
const view = mat4LookAt([0, 5, 10], [0, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]);
const model = mat4();  // Identity

// Into variant for hot loops (no allocation)
const mvp = mat4();
mat4Multiply(mvp, view, model);  // mvp = view * model
mat4Multiply(mvp, proj, mvp);    // mvp = proj * view * model

// Quaternion rotation
const rot = quatFromEuler(0, Math.PI/4, 0);  // 45° Y rotation
```

**See also:** [Math Library](/engine/math.md)
